integrity: The proof determines the exact least concave majorant and greatest convex minorant of the binomial point-mass curve. All endpoint directing measures are explicit. Exact-rational computation replays, but does not replace, the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers interior counts only: 1 <= k <= n-1.
Only the marginal mean of the directing variable is fixed; additional mixing moments would alter the envelope.
The originality search was targeted and may miss an equivalent result under older moment-problem terminology.
title: Sharp exact-count envelope under infinite Bernoulli exchangeability
